idea-plugin.name: New Dark
idea-plugin.description:
New Dark is a dark editor color scheme for IntelliJ-based IDEs, based on JetBrains' New Dark theme. It provides a refined palette with carefully chosen colors for keywords, strings, numbers, functions, parameters, and comments, tuned for readability with the new UI.
Created because the official New Dark theme plugin is not supported in IDE versions 2026.3 and later.
